title: Evaluating Moisturizing Performance of Injectable Sodium Hyaluronate
author: Shi, Jianfeng
materials: HuFullKutis Full-Thickness Skin Model and model culture medium were supplied by Jinan Pansheng Biotechnology Co., Ltd. HaCaT cells were purchased from National Collection of Authenticated Cell Cultures. Dulbecco’s Modified Eagle Medium (DMEM) and fetal bovine serum (FBS) were purchased from Gibco. Phosphate buffered saline (PBS) and Trypsin-EDTA were purchased from HyClone. Ammonium formate and methanol were obtained from Macklin. Acetonitrile was purchased from Concord. Proteinase K, penicillin-streptomycin solution (PS), TdT-mediated dUTP Nick-End Labeling (TUNEL) Apoptosis Assay Kit (Green Fluorescence), Reactive Oxygen Species (ROS) Assay Kit (Green Fluorescence), Cell Counting Kit-8 (CCK-8) kit and 4% paraformaldehyde were purchased from Solaibio. Deionized water was purchased from Grade I. Absolute ethanol was purchased from Sinopharm. Eco-friendly dewaxing transparent solution, citrate antigen repair solution (pH 6.0), EDTA antigen repair solution (pH 9.0), tissue autofluorescence quencher, bovine serum albumin (BSA), Anti-AQP3 Rabbit pAb, Anti-CD44 Rabbit pAb, Cy3-conjugated goat anti-rabbit IgG, DAPI staining reagent and anti-fade mounting medium were purchased from Servicebio. RNeasy Mini Kit was purchased from QIAGEN. One Step TB Green PrimeScript RT PCR Kit was purchased from TAKARA.

The structural characteristics of samples A–D were analyzed using FTIR spectroscopy (Thermo Nicolet iS50, USA). Before measurement, each sample was lyophilized in a desiccator for 4 h to eliminate residual moisture. Approximately 1–2 mg of the dried sample was finely ground with potassium bromide (KBr) and pressed into pellets. The spectra were recorded over the range of 4000–500 cm−1 with a resolution of 4 cm−1. Each spectrum was averaged over 32 scans to enhance the signal-to-noise ratio.

The mRNA expression levels of hydration-related genes (AQP3, CD44, and FLG) were quantified using quantitative real-time PCR (qRT-PCR). Total RNA was extracted from HaCaT cells using the RNeasy Mini Kit following the manufacturer’s protocol. Reverse transcription and amplification were performed using the One Step TB Green PrimeScript RT-PCR Kit on a Real-Time PCR Detection System (QuantStudio5, Bio-Rad). Relative gene expression was calculated using the 2−△△Ct method, with β-actin serving as the internal reference. The primer sequences used are listed in Table 1.

steps.title: Collect and label NaHA products
steps.instruction: Obtain four injectable sodium hyaluronate (NaHA) products from the Chinese market and label them sequentially as A–D with concentrations of 10 mg/mL, 15 mg/mL, 15 mg/mL and 5 mg/mL respectively.

steps.title: Prepare FTIR pellets
steps.instruction: Lyophilize each NaHA sample in a desiccator for 4 h, weigh 1–2 mg of the dried material, grind with potassium bromide (KBr), and press into pellets; record FTIR spectra from 4000 to 500 cm⁻¹ at 4 cm⁻¹ resolution, averaging 32 scans per spectrum.

steps.title: Acquire Raman spectra of liquid NaHA
steps.instruction: Using a LabRAM Soleil confocal Raman microscope (532 nm laser, 600 grooves/mm grating, 50× objective), acquire spectra with a 10 s acquisition time; for liquid samples set laser power to 67 mW, then increase to 84 mW and extend acquisition time to 30 s to improve signal‑to‑noise.

steps.title: Lyophilize samples and record spectra
steps.instruction: Dispense NaHA solutions into 35 mm dishes and freeze‑dry: primary drying at –40 °C for 2 h, secondary drying at –80 °C for 2 h; collect spectra of the resulting powders under the same Raman conditions; process data with baseline correction, normalize to 3100–3700 cm⁻¹, and deconvolute the O–H stretching band.

steps.title: Prepare mobile phase and run HPSEC‑MALLS
steps.instruction: Dissolve 11.7 g NaCl in water to 1 L (0.2 mol L⁻¹), filter through a 0.22 µm membrane and degas; prepare NaHA sample solutions at ~1 mg mL⁻¹ in the same mobile phase (filter mobile phase again through 0.22 µm); equilibrate a Shodex SB‑806HQ column (8.0 mm × 300 mm) at 1.0 mL min⁻¹ flow; inject 100 µL of sample, record UV, RI and MALLS signals; calculate Mw, Mn and Mw/Mn using ASTRA software with dn/dc = 0.160 mL g⁻¹.

steps.title: Assess rheological properties
steps.instruction: Measure viscosity of samples A–D on a Physica MCR301 rheometer with CP50‑1 cone‑plate (diameter 50 mm, angle 1°, gap 0.110 mm) at 25 ± 0.2 °C; perform a flow sweep from 0.001 to 1000 s⁻¹ (logarithmic steps) and record apparent viscosity, extracting values at shear rates 0.0562, 0.1, 0.562, 1, 5.62, 10, 56.2 and 100 s⁻¹.

steps.title: Maintain HaCaT cells and skin model
steps.instruction: Culture HaCaT cells in DMEM with 10 % FBS and 1 % penicillin‑streptomycin (complete medium), passaging every 2 days; keep full‑thickness skin models submerged in the same medium; incubate all at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Evaluate cytotoxicity with CCK‑8
steps.instruction: Seed HaCaT cells at 1 × 10⁵ cells well⁻¹ in a 96‑well plate, incubate 24 h; replace medium with serial dilutions of Sample D (final volume ratios 6.125 %–100 %) in complete medium, incubate 24 h; add 10 % (v/v) CCK‑8 solution, incubate additional 2 h; measure absorbance at 450 nm.

steps.title: Perform scratch wound assay
steps.instruction: Seed HaCaT cells at 5 × 10⁵ cells well⁻¹ in 6‑well plates, grow to ~90 % confluence; create a linear scratch with a sterile 200 µL pipette tip, wash twice with PBS; add serum‑free DMEM containing Sample D at 25 %, 50 % or 75 % (volume ratios) or serum‑free DMEM alone as negative control; capture images at 0, 12 and 24 h with an inverted fluorescence microscope and quantify wound closure using ImageJ.

steps.title: Drying‑damage assay with CCK‑8, TUNEL, ROS
steps.instruction: Seed HaCaT cells at 1 × 10⁵ cells well⁻¹ in 96‑well plates, incubate 24 h; wash twice with PBS; treat for 24 h with Sample D (25 %, 50 %, 75 % v/v), PBS (model control), 5 % glycerol (positive control) or complete medium alone (blank); aspirate all liquid, place plate in biosafety cabinet and expose to drying stress for 20 min at room temperature with air velocity 0.32–0.4 m s⁻¹ (blank wells not aspirated, no drying); assess viability with CCK‑8 as above, assess apoptosis with TUNEL kit and oxidative stress with ROS kit, image on a confocal laser scanning microscope (488 nm excitation) and analyze mean fluorescence intensity (MFI) with ImageJ.

steps.title: Quantify gene expression by qRT‑PCR
steps.instruction: Extract total RNA from treated HaCaT cells using the RNeasy Mini Kit; perform reverse transcription and PCR amplification with One Step TB Green PrimeScript RT‑PCR Kit on a QuantStudio 5 system; use β‑actin as internal reference and calculate relative expression of AQP3, CD44 and FLG by the 2⁻ΔΔCt method (primer sequences as listed in Table 1).

steps.title: Engineer RhFS models – inclusion method
steps.instruction: Mix dermal fibroblasts, culture medium and collagen solution, add to a Transwell insert; before full gelation create a 2.1 mm‑deep indentation on the collagen surface using a sterile glass ring aligned with a reference mark; dispense 100 µL of Sample D into the indentation; overlay remaining collagen‑fibroblast mixture to encapsulate the NaHA depot.

steps.title: Engineer RhFS models – mixing method
steps.instruction: Combine 100 µL of Sample D directly with the dermal fibroblast‑collagen mixture, then cast the homogeneous mixture into a Transwell insert, yielding a dispersed NaHA distribution.

steps.title: Culture RhFS models for stratification
steps.instruction: Culture NaHA‑free RhFS constructs as controls and all engineered constructs for 7 days to allow dermal maturation; seed an epidermal cell suspension onto the dermal surface and culture submerged for 4 days; lift models to the air‑liquid interface and culture an additional 10 days to promote epidermal stratification and cornification.

steps.title: Process RhFS and prepare sample solution
steps.instruction: Excise RhFS from the Transwell edge with a blade, separate the epidermal layer with forceps into a 1.5 mL tube; add 500 µL proteinase K (0.2 mg mL⁻¹) and incubate at 50 °C for 1 h; collect the isolated stratum corneum (SC) with forceps into a new tube, add 250 µL methanol, sonicate 30 min, centrifuge 14 000 rpm at 4 °C for 10 min; transfer supernatant, evaporate to dryness under nitrogen, reconstitute in 250 µL ultrapure water, sonicate 30 min, centrifuge 12 000 rpm at 4 °C for 10 min; transfer 194 µL supernatant to an HPLC vial insert, add 5 µL of 1 M ammonium formate stock and 2.5 µL acetonitrile, vortex to obtain the final analysis solution.

steps.title: Measure Raman maps in superficial region
steps.instruction: Deliver PBS or NaHA into RhFS by the inclusion method (controls receive no delivery); using LabRAM Soleil confocal Raman microscope, acquire Raman maps within ~200 µm of the tissue surface to monitor time‑dependent water content changes; process maps with LabSpec 6 software.

steps.title: Analyze sample by HPLC
steps.instruction: Inject 40 µL of the prepared sample solution into an LC‑20A HPLC equipped with a C18 column (5 µm, 4.6 × 250 mm); use a mobile phase of 990 mL 20 mmol L⁻¹ ammonium formate + 10 mL acetonitrile, flow 0.4 mL min⁻¹, column temperature 30 °C; detect at 270 nm for urocanic acid (UCA) and 210 nm for pyrrolidone carboxylic acid (PCA); note retention times: PCA 7.2 min, trans‑UCA 9.9 min, cis‑UCA 17.9 min.

steps.title: Immunofluorescence staining of tissue
steps.instruction: At chosen time points, excise RhFS, embed and freeze‑section; incubate sections overnight at 4 °C with primary rabbit polyclonal anti‑CD44/AQP3 antibody; wash, then incubate 50 min at room temperature in the dark with Cy3‑conjugated goat anti‑rabbit IgG; apply DAPI solution, incubate 10 min at room temperature in the dark; image with a D‑Eclipse C1 confocal microscope and quantify mean fluorescence intensity using ImageJ.

steps.title: Prepare gradient Sample D solutions for RNA‑seq
steps.instruction: Divide HaCaT cells into four groups; treat the experimental groups with Sample D at 10 %, 25 % and 50 % volume ratios for 24 h, while the negative control receives no NaHA; extract total RNA, perform high‑throughput sequencing, conduct quality control, normalization, differential expression analysis (DESeq2, fold change > 1.5, adjusted P < 0.05), and KEGG pathway enrichment (P < 0.05).

steps.title: Statistical analysis of data
steps.instruction: Express all results as mean ± SD; for multiple dose comparisons use one‑way ANOVA with Tukey’s post‑hoc test; for two‑group delivery‑method comparisons use unpaired two‑tailed Student’s t‑test; consider P < 0.05 statistically significant; perform analyses and generate figures with GraphPad Prism 9.5.
